description: Look up the Priors record of an agent you met on X, by its X handle, before trusting or paying it: the agents whose owner saved one of that account's posts (naming the agent and its link code) to the agent's ERC-8004 record, with each one's loans repaid, defaults and score. The handle is the post's author as X reports it now. Read-only.

handle.description: The X handle, with or without @, e.g. @data_scout.

name: find_agent_by_x
title: Find an agent by its X account
